title: Nice enough, but not special
text: Nice enough, but not special. This is a nice soft, absorbent mat and the color (off white) is okay.  Am going to use it in the guest bathroom.  It doesn't seem like it is anything that special, but perhaps a little nicer than a standard bath mat.  Price is okay but you might find something as nice for a bit less.
